players.product: precision cleaning and specialty coating of etch / deposition chamber parts, plus ceramic parts (heaters / ESCs via its subsidiary MiCo Ceramics)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 333,021,814,899 versus KRW 280,964,828,746 in H1 2025, while H1 operating profit fell to KRW 47,500,560,227 from KRW 61,422,288,020. Q2 2026 revenue KRW 175,961,637,381 (Q2 2025: KRW 146,003,399,733) with Q2 operating profit KRW 27,050,200,983 (Q2 2025: KRW 30,164,038,414). H1 net profit KRW 26,125,088,036, of which KRW 8,073,364,367 attributable to owners of the parent. SG&A rose to KRW 94,246,806 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 65,474,908 thousand), including R&D of KRW 23,386,145 thousand.

Mix, H1 2026: cleaning KRW 74,532M (22.4%), coating KRW 89,235M (26.8%) and parts KRW 169,255M (50.8%); the parts line is MiCo Ceramics' ceramic heaters (AlN, for CVD / ALD deposition tools) and electrostatic chucks (for etch tools), which Komico's overseas subsidiaries also resell to chipmakers and equipment makers. MiCo Ceramics (64.54% owned) posted H1 revenue of KRW 149,475,601 thousand and net profit of KRW 48,731,545 thousand. Revenue by region: Korea KRW 134,543,309 thousand, Asia KRW 160,699,829 thousand, US KRW 35,215,549 thousand, Europe KRW 2,563,128 thousand.

quarterly_data.signal: Customers: 96.8% of H1 revenue (KRW 322,508M) came from semiconductors. The group 'Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and others' accounted for KRW 113,478M (34.0%) and 'Intel, TSMC, Micron and others' for KRW 209,030M (62.8%). Two customers each exceeded 10% of consolidated revenue: customer A KRW 68,119,190 thousand and customer B KRW 45,358,858 thousand (names not disclosed). Named customers by site: Korea - Samsung, SK hynix, DongWon Parts, DB HiTek, SEMES, ASM International; US - Samsung (Austin), TSMC, Intel, GlobalFoundries, Micron, NXP, Texas Instruments; Taiwan - TSMC, UMC, Micron, PSMC, Winbond; China - SK hynix (Wuxi), YMTC, CXMT, BOE, CSOT; Singapore - Micron, UMC, Intel, GlobalFoundries. Komico says four vendors (including itself) compete for Samsung's cleaning / coating business and six for SK hynix's.

quarterly_data.signal: Utilisation, H1 2026 (units): Anseong cleaning 52.2% and coating 70.3%; Austin cleaning 92.3% and coating 41.1%; Hillsboro cleaning 16.3% and coating 72.9%; Wuxi cleaning 42.2% and coating 68.7%; Hsinchu cleaning 83.0% and coating 79.4%; Singapore cleaning 61.0% and coating 36.8%; newly consolidated Huanggang cleaning 12.6%; MiCo Ceramics ceramic parts 79.6% (FY2025: 89.4%). Komico says low indicated cleaning utilisation reflects capacity counted for small bulk parts and deliberate spare capacity held for customers' new fabs ('Ready to Run'), not weak orders. Cleaning / coating is run on customer forecasts and ad-hoc orders, so no order backlog is kept.
quarterly_data.figure: Austin cleaning 92.3%; Hsinchu cleaning 83.0%; Anseong cleaning 52.2%, coating 70.3%; Hillsboro cleaning 16.3%; MiCo Ceramics 79.6%

quarterly_data.signal: Capex and footprint: consolidated PP&E additions in H1 2026 were KRW 135,211M and construction in progress reached KRW 273,747M (from KRW 204,491M); cash paid for PP&E was KRW 117,269,735,833. Commitments to acquire PP&E at June 30: MiCo Ceramics KRW 98,002,176 thousand, KoMiCo Taiwan KRW 66,159,644 thousand, KoMiCo Phoenix KRW 39,784,858 thousand. MiCo Ceramics has been adding capacity in Anseong and Gangneung since 2025 (Gangneung plant 4 investment to be completed by 2027-05-06); KoMiCo Taiwan is building a second plant in Tainan to follow TSMC's Tainan fab capacity; KoMiCo Phoenix serves TSMC and Intel in Arizona. New in 2026: TaMiCo Zatec (Czech Republic, set up 2026-02-26) to clean and coat parts for ESMC, the TSMC-Bosch-Infineon-NXP fab in Dresden; and Brickyard Cove Limited (now KoMiCo Ireland), acquired 2026-06-03 for US$ 1M including a lease takeover, to serve Intel's Fab 34 (Intel 3/4) in Ireland. The board approved a PP&E acquisition on 2026-06-01 (amount not stated).
